Original zip: kenney_pixel-ui-pack.zip from
  https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/pixel-ui-pack/821e760f21-1677661508/kenney_pixel-ui-pack.zip
Original zip sha256: b76f2f60f2be76eb8e66511038fa4d48faec11e638316fa37d06084878cdf0c7
Format: 48x48 px "9-slice" panel textures (a handful of border/fill styles x
  several colorways) plus a combined spritesheet of buttons/icons/cursors.
  Version 1.0, released 2015 -- an old, simple pack, not the newer "UI Pack: RPG
  Expansion" (which itch.io currently sells as part of a bundle; this Pixel UI
  Pack is the free CC0 original and is what's downloaded here).
Covers: bordered dialog/panel backgrounds (usable as a stand-in for the game's
  dialog box and minimap/quest-tracker frames after recoloring), plus generic
  buttons and cursors.
Does not cover: a bitmap font (the game keeps "Press Start 2P" regardless), or
  anything close to the game's current cream-border-on-navy pixel-corner look --
  this pack's panels have flat colors and rounded corners, a different visual
  language that would need real rework, not just recoloring, to fit.
